purpose: Release oversized MSAA targets when the window shrinks, and reclaim cold image entries and empty atlas pages.
local_changes: src/triangle/msaa.rs: recreate MSAA targets whenever the region size differs, including when it shrinks; leave the ratio calculation unchanged
src/image/{cache,mod,raster,vector}.rs: expire cold raster and SVG entries independently of insertion, preserving live allocations and bind groups
src/image/atlas.rs: recreate an unreferenced empty atlas at its backend baseline
src/image/{tests.rs,atlas/tests.rs} (added): regression checks for image cache aging, active resources, and GPU operations recorded before an idle reset
LICENSE (added): Iced's MIT license, which the crate package does not include; the same text as licenses/iced/LICENSE
